notes.title: patch 6-20-25
notes.content: [p]made some tweaks to the first level tutorial experience - hopefully this will make the game more clear for new players[/p][p]added the ability to modify the "Grouping" on runes to keep certain runes from interacting with each other. Runes will now only interact with other runes in the same "Group" or color. [/p][p]removed the duplicate red and blue runes since that can now be modified and does not require separate items[/p]

tags.feature: -added the ability to modify the "Grouping" on runes to keep certain runes from interacting with each other. Runes will now only interact with other runes in the same "Group" or color.
-removed the duplicate red and blue runes since that can now be modified and does not require separate items

notes.title: patch 6-8-25
notes.content: [p]Fixed a number of bug affecting the demo and playtest[/p][p]-patched a hole in the first map where players could fall into the void[/p][p]-fixed an issue that allowed bosses to leave their arenas[/p][p]-fixed an some occlusion issues[/p][p]-fixed a bug causing some bosses to not properly register melee hits on the player[/p][p]-fixed the Library Text in the HUB[/p][p][/p][p]the biggest change is fixed an issue that would cause saved data to sporadically become corrupted, unfortunately this means that current progress had to be wiped[/p][p]I apologize for the inconvenience[/p]

tags.bug: [p]Fixed a number of bug affecting the demo and playtest[/p]
[p]-patched a hole in the first map where players could fall into the void[/p]
[p]-fixed an issue that allowed bosses to leave their arenas[/p]
[p]-fixed a bug causing some bosses to not properly register melee hits on the player[/p]
[p]-fixed the Library Text in the HUB[/p]
[p]the biggest change is fixed an issue that would cause saved data to sporadically become corrupted, unfortunately this means that current progress had to be wiped[/p]
